title: Ada Null - Dyke sex and ennui: Generating unending narrative in 'Kiss Garden'
speaker: Ada Null
talk_title: Dyke sex and ennui: Generating unending narrative in 'Kiss Garden'
description: What if it just never damn ends? We typically design procedural generators with aspirations of unique, emergent outcomes, but perhaps there's a value to the sludge. I explore the development of my receipt printer artwork 'Kiss Garden', and how it generates an endless narrative of failing relationships while maintaining a forward momentum.
